episodes.title: Limbic Resonance
episodes.summary: Eight strangers from cities around the globe begin having experiences that defy explanation.

episodes.title: I Am Also a We
episodes.summary: Nomi's fortunes take a dark turn, while the rest of the Sensates' connections become stronger and more dangerous.

episodes.title: Smart Money's on the Skinny Bitch
episodes.summary: With many of the Sensates' lives becoming more complicated, their newfound gift -- while still a mystery -- proves vital for survival.

episodes.title: What's Going On?
episodes.summary: Nomi's fate draws nearer, Capheus and Wolfgang's fortunes seem to have turned, but Sun is faced with an impossible choice.

episodes.title: Art is Like Religion
episodes.summary: The Sensates struggle with intensifying connections, which results in some interesting days on set for Lito and a wedding day surprise for Kala.

episodes.title: Demons
episodes.summary: While the Sensates bond, Nomi takes a bold move to gain her freedom and Sun makes a choice she might someday regret.

episodes.title: WWN Double-D?
episodes.summary: Nomi makes a shocking discovery about her former doctor, while Will gets closer to the truth behind his visions and Kala's doubts grow stronger.

episodes.title: We Will All Be Judged by the Courage of Our Hearts
episodes.summary: Sun fights to adjust to her new life as Capheus tries to change his. Will and Nomi dig up disturbing information that could change everything.

episodes.title: Death Doesn't Let You Say Goodbye
episodes.summary: Riley learns about her new life and its dangers, Kala deals with the aftermath of the attack on Rajan's father, and Lito's world spins out of control.

episodes.title: What is Human?
episodes.summary: Will learns more about his origins and the threat to his future, while Wolfgang's actions catch up with him, even as his bond with Kala strengthens.

episodes.title: Just Turn the Wheel and the Future Changes
episodes.summary: Riley's fate draws nearer, while Capheus and Sun are put to the test, and Wolfgang makes his boldest move yet.

episodes.title: I Can't Leave Her
episodes.summary: With Riley in the hands of Whispers, all of the Sensates' skills are needed to give them any chance at survival.

episodes.title: Who Am I?
episodes.summary: Will risks the cluster's secrecy to try and find Whispers' location. Meanwhile, Lito attends his movie premiere, Felix receives an unexpected gift, and Nomi and Amanita investigate the origins of Homo sensorium.

episodes.title: Obligate Mutualisms
episodes.summary: After arranging Whispers' apparent downfall, Will makes contact with Croome, the chairman of BPO. Meanwhile, Wolfgang meets a member of another cluster and receives a job offer.

episodes.title: Polyphony
episodes.summary: Will escapes the museum in Amsterdam with the help of his clustermates, and Lito tracks down Raoul. Meanwhile, Kala and Capheus both find themselves in riots, and Bendix finds Amanita.

episodes.title: Fear Never Fixed Anything
episodes.summary: Bug contacts an organization that can redact all of Nomi's records, taking her off the grid. Meanwhile, Lito gets an invitation to a Gay Pride Parade, and the clusters decides to stop hiding.

episodes.title: Isolated Above, Connected Below
episodes.summary: Kala gives in to her heart but then asks Wolfgang to help her not to. Meanwhile, Riley meets with an eccentric Scottish Sensate from the rave, and Nomi and Amanita track down the cabin where Angelica did her research.

episodes.title: I Have No Room in My Heart for Hate
episodes.summary: While Riley travels to Chicago, Nomi and Amanita get a lead on Whispers' current operations. Meanwhile, Kala discovers that Rajan is selling expired drugs to third-world countries, and Sun visits her parents' mausoleum.

episodes.title: All I Want Right Now is One More Bullet
episodes.summary: The war in Berlin heats up as Lila makes her intentions clear to Berlin. Meanwhile, Lito bemoans the loss of his career, Capheus meets an old friend, and Nomi tries on high heels.

episodes.title: What Family Actually Means
episodes.summary: Nomi prepares for her sister Teagan's wedding, much to her mother's disapproval. Meanwhile, Ajay delivers a present to Kala and Rajan, and Dani finds the perfect role for Lito.

episodes.title: If All the World's a Stage, Identity is Nothing But a Costume
episodes.summary: Capheus' first political speech is marred by violence. Meanwhile, Sun and Lito prepare for their new roles, and Will deals with his father's death.

episodes.title: You Want a War?
episodes.summary: Sun goes after her brother and discovers that he has political connections. , Kala prepares to leave Bombay to be with Wolfgang, but Whispers finds him first. Meanwhile, Nomi has a proposal for Amanita.
